Esri World_Imagery 45.9039,-100.2899 hw 300/1500 m, 45.9049,-100.2880 hw 110 m, 45.9042,-100.2935 hw 160 m, 2026-11-22: the pin sits on SD 1804 at Pollock's north edge. East of the highway, a grassy park between tree shelterbelts with a two-track loop along the Lake Pocasse shore (one RV parked ~55 m from the water, trees and the loop track between); west of the highway a park with shelters, playground and ball fields. No numbered pads, electric posts or toilets resolvable
summary: No current source for a 'Lake Pocasse Campground (Campbell County)': only 2012-era aggregator data; Google lists nothing. The Town of Pollock runs FCFS donation camping ($10 suggested) at its North Park (no electric) and East Park (four 110 V outlets); the pin lies between parks of that kind on SD 1804 by the lake, but which one this entry is cannot be told. Stored booking (phone reservations), $5 rate, 32-ft max, May-Sep season all rest on the stale listing. No groups written; identity/inclusion flag for the reviewer. Lakeview plausible (no named sites).
